about: Bolts that finish what the art's own hands begin (render/vfx/HandBoltFx, MapStage handBoltFor). Per unit (catalog key) and pose: where the glow is on each frame of the pose (full-image uv, u from the left as drawn facing right, v from the top), the frame its charge starts on and the frame it lets go on (1-based), the look. The bolt flies from the release frame's point to the struck body; the blow lands when it arrives. Measured from the frames' blue glow (build/video-cut/apparition-centre). Look "arcane": no track and no arcs of its own; the plain arcane bolt every caster throws (vfx/CombatFx, at the pose's impact) leaves from "release", the hand on the frame the pose lets go ("releaseFrame", 1-based, of "frames"), in place of a point guessed at the chest. With "hands" (the palm on each frame of the pose, measured from the art) and "chargeFrame", the heroes' arcane energy (vfx/ArcaneFx, the plain attack's small size) gathers on the palm as drawn from that frame until the release, and flies from it (the user, 2026-11-25: "quando é que vai fazer um efeito na MÃO do cultista").

apparition.why: the user, 2026-11-10: the old WebGL 2D ApparitionLightningV1 (Engine2 vfx/legacy/two-d) in 3D, only to the foe she strikes: arcs between her hands while the glow gathers, the bolt as her hands thrust out

blackCultist.why: the user, 2026-11-25: "eu preciso de um efeito visual para o ataque do Cultista Negro": his attack is his cast clip (cut.json impactFrame 13 = cast-14.png, the open hand thrust out); the palm measured on that frame (the centroid of the hand's opaque pixels); the bolt is the casters' plain one, smaller than any spell (the user: "sem magias exageradas")

_telesm.why: the user, 2026-11-10: Telesm's cast (TelesmMoveand Casting.mp4) throws the cyan version of this bolt; its track goes here, key 'telesm', look 'telesm', once its frames are cut (build/video-cut/telesm)
